tiers.auto: Act with no approval. Internal-only, no external send, no commercial or financial risk.

tiers.brian-sends: Kerri drafts only; Brian sends manually from his own mailbox.
tiers.never-auto: Permanent hard gate. No track record promotes these.

conditions: Every recipient (To + Cc) of the outgoing reply exactly matches an address in trustedInternal. One non-matching address means fall back to ask.

Send identity is Kerri (kerri@hardwarefyi.com) for an H/G job, OR the Superhuman S/W account (brian@standardandworks.com) for an internal-only S-prefix job. POST-CALL SENDER LOCK and Gmail (brian@kerrihq.com) draft-only jobs still fall back to ask.

Prefix gate: H or G auto-send as Kerri. S-prefix (Standard & Works) auto-sends ONLY when internal-only -- every To+Cc recipient is in trustedInternal (Brian/Zach/Kerri) and no external party is on the reply; it then sends via Superhuman from brian@standardandworks.com with NO HWFYI auto-CC and boundary-safe brain writes (body scrubbed from jobs.json). Any external recipient on an S-prefix reply -> never auto-sends, fall back to ask.
The no-double-email gate runs exactly as for approved sends.
The reply makes no commitment on pricing, legal, finance, spend, CRM, or scope. If the draft would, fall back to ask.
Policy file unreadable or class missing: fall back to ask. Fail closed, always.

cold-send.note: Brand + volume risk. One-checkbox daily batch stays.

graduation.demotion: Automatic back to ask on any double-email, any Brian 'that was wrong' on an auto-logged send, or edit rate regression above maxEditRate. Kerri MAY demote unilaterally (demotion is always allowed; promotion never is).

notifications.neverText: Auto-logged sends never use the Sendblue/text path. Texts mean act today. Decided by Brian 2026-06-09.
